units.source_text: 源氏看见夕雾至今尚未定亲，觉得奇怪，替他担心。

en.t: Genji found it strange that Yugiri was still not engaged, and he worried about him.

units.source_text: 有一次对他言道：“你对那人如果已经断念，则右大臣和中务亲王都想将女儿许配与你，由你自己选定吧。”

en.t: Once he said to him, "If you have already given up on that person, both the Minister of the Right and the Prince of the Ministry of Central Affairs wish to marry their daughters to you, so choose for yourself."

units.source_text: 但夕雾默默不答，只是毕恭毕敬地坐着。

en.t: But Yugiri remained silent and gave no answer, sitting there with the utmost respect.

units.source_text: 源氏又说：“讲到此种事情，我也是连桐壶父皇的宝贵教训都不肯听从，所以我对你不想多嘴。

en.t: Genji went on, "When it comes to such matters, I myself would not even listen to the precious teachings of my father, the Kiritsubo Emperor, so I do not wish to lecture you too much.

units.source_text: 然而过后回想，这种教训正是颠扑不破的真理。

en.t: Yet when I looked back afterward, I saw that such teachings were truths that could not be overturned.

units.source_text: 你今年已十八，还是独居无偶，世人都在猜量，以为你怀抱高远之志。

en.t: You are already eighteen this year and still live alone without a wife, so people are all speculating that you must have very lofty ambitions.

units.source_text: 如果你为宿缘所拘，结果娶了一个凡庸女子，这就变成虎头蛇尾，惹人耻笑了。

en.t: If you are bound by some old karmic tie and end up marrying an ordinary woman, it will look like a grand beginning with a poor ending and invite ridicule.

units.source_text: 即使怀抱高远之志，结果未必如意称心。

en.t: Even if you do cherish lofty hopes, the outcome may not necessarily be as you wish.

units.source_text: 要知世事都有限量，不可过分诛求挑剔。

en.t: You should understand that worldly matters all have their limits, and you must not demand too much or be overly fastidious.

units.source_text: 我自幼生长宫中，一举一动，不能任意，生活十分拘束。

en.t: From childhood I was raised in the palace, where I could not act as I pleased in even the smallest movement, and my life was extremely constrained.

units.source_text: 略有过失，便会遭受轻率之讥，故必须时时小心翼翼。

en.t: If I made even a slight mistake, I would be criticized as careless, so I had to be constantly cautious.

units.source_text: 然而还是获得了好色的罪名，长受世人讥议。

en.t: Even so, I gained the reputation of being amorous and have long been criticized by the world.

units.source_text: 你官位还低，不受拘束，但切不可因此而毫无顾忌，任情行事。

en.t: Your rank is still low and you are not much constrained, but for that very reason you must never act without restraint or follow every impulse.

units.source_text: 人心倘不抑制，自会骄傲起来。

en.t: If the human heart is not held in check, it naturally grows proud.

units.source_text: 此时倘无心爱之人来镇定其心，贤人也会为了女人之事而身败名裂。

en.t: At such a time, if there is no beloved person to steady the heart, even a wise man can ruin himself and lose his good name over a woman.

units.source_text: 此种事例，古来甚多。

en.t: There have been many such examples since ancient times.

units.source_text: 倘向不应该爱的人求爱，结果是使对方蒙受恶名，使自己遭人怨恨，成为终身憾事。

en.t: If you seek love from someone you should not love, the result is that you bring disgrace upon the other person, make yourself hated, and create a lifelong regret.

units.source_text: 倘因疏误而成亲，而其人不称我心，则即使到了难于忍耐之时，亦当回心转意，竭力宽容：

en.t: If through some mistake you marry and the person does not suit your heart, then even when things become hard to endure, you should change your mind and do your utmost to be tolerant:

units.source_text: 或者看她父母面上，曲予原谅；或者父母已死，娘家衰落，而其人具有可爱之处，则亦应重视此优点而与之偕老。

en.t: Either forgive her, even against your inclination, out of regard for her parents; or, if her parents have died and her family has declined, but she has lovable qualities, you should value that merit and grow old together with her.

units.source_text: 总之，为自己计，为对方计，都应深思远虑，务求善始善终。”

en.t: In short, for your own sake and for the other person's sake as well, you should think deeply and look far ahead, striving to begin well and end well."

units.source_text: 每当闲暇无事之时，源氏总拿这一类话来教导夕雾。

en.t: Whenever he had leisure and nothing else to do, Genji would instruct Yugiri with words of this kind.

units.source_text: 夕雾听从父亲的训话。

en.t: Yugiri obeyed his father's admonitions.

units.source_text: 他有时恋慕别的女子，即使是逢场作戏，亦认为自造罪孽，对不起云居雁。

en.t: At times he felt drawn to other women, but even if it was only a passing flirtation, he considered it a sin of his own making and felt that he was wronging Kumoi no Kari.
